entries.name: sketch.block.area
entries.description: Get the area of a block.

entries.name: sketch.block.block
entries.description: Get a block neighbor. The neighbor is the block attached to the source block at the edge with index i. Edge indices on a block start at 1.

entries.name: sketch.block.center
entries.description: Get the center point of a block. For regular (3- or 4-sided) blocks, the function returns the coordinates of the geometric center of the block and for irregular blocks it returns the geometric center of the largest zone in the block.

entries.name: sketch.block.check
entries.description: Get the validity of a block. Possible return values: 1 = valid, 0 = not valid.

entries.name: sketch.block.countedges
entries.description: Get the total number of edges in the block.

entries.name: sketch.block.countzones
entries.description: Get the total number of zones in the block.

entries.name: sketch.block.create.at
entries.description: Create a meshed block from the edges surrounding the point at position v. Current meshing parameters are used. Will return null if block creation fails (e.g., if the specified position is outside of any closed polygon).

entries.name: sketch.block.create.auto
entries.description: Create blocks automatically from the closed edge loops of the sketch set, using the current meshing parameters (the 'sketch block create auto' action); returns true on success.

entries.name: sketch.block.edge
entries.description: Get a pointer to a block edge. Edge indices on a block start at 1.

entries.name: sketch.block.extra
entries.description: Get/set the value stored in the ith extra variable array of block bp.

entries.name: sketch.block.find
entries.description: Get the block with ID i.

entries.name: sketch.block.flip
entries.description: Get the “flipped” state of a block edge.

entries.name: sketch.block.grid.pos
entries.description: The function only applies to regular (3- or 4-sided) blocks with structured mesh.

entries.name: sketch.block.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to sketch block b in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: sketch.block.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the block in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: sketch.block.id
entries.description: Get the block ID number, a unique number assigned by the code when it is created.

entries.name: sketch.block.irregular.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of the block. For irregular blocks (blocks with unstructured mesh), this will always return 1486667164.

entries.name: sketch.block.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the block and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: sketch.block.list
entries.description: Get a pointer to the container of all blocks in the sketch set.

entries.name: sketch.block.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum ID number assigned to any block in the set sp. The next block created will be assigned this value plus one.

entries.name: sketch.block.multiplier
entries.description: The function only applies to regular (3- or 4-sided) blocks with structured mesh. The multiplier for irregular blocks is always 1.

entries.name: sketch.block.near
entries.description: Get the nearest block to v. Will return null if there are no blocks in the sketch set.

entries.name: sketch.block.next.block
entries.description: Get the next block connected to the edge with local index i within the source block bp. This can be used to iterate through all blocks connected to an edge using the sketch.block.next.index function.

entries.name: sketch.block.next.index
entries.description: Get local index ir of a sketch edge within the next block attached to this edge (note: the same edge has local index i within the source block p).

entries.name: sketch.block.nodes
entries.description: Get the list of 2D vectors that correspond to the positions of the nodes of an element with local index i within the block bp. The index can vary from 1 to sketch.block.countzones.

entries.name: sketch.block.num
entries.description: Get the total number of blocks in the set sp.

entries.name: sketch.block.param.pos
entries.description: The function only applies to regular (3- or 4-sided) blocks with structured mesh.

entries.name: sketch.block.point
entries.description: Get a point (vertex) of a block. Point indices start with 1 and must not be more than the number of vertices on the boundaries of the block.

entries.name: sketch.block.regular.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of the block. For regular blocks (3- or 4- sided blocks with structured mesh), this will always return 1286571647.

entries.name: sketch.block.size
entries.description: Get the number of edges on all the boundaries of a block (including internal boundaries, if any). This will equal the number of points on the block.

entries.name: sketch.block.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of object. For blocks, this will always return 1486667202.

entries.name: sketch.block.zones.i
entries.description: The function only applies to regular (3- or 4-sided) blocks with structured mesh.

entries.name: sketch.block.zones.j
entries.description: The function only applies to regular (3- or 4-sided) blocks with structured mesh.

entries.name: sketch.edge.blocked
entries.description: Get block attachment state of an edge. Possible return values: 1 = there is at least one block attached to the edge; 0 = no block is attached to the edge.

entries.name: sketch.edge.blocks
entries.description: Get the list of all blocks connected to the edge e

entries.name: sketch.edge.center
entries.description: Get the position (2D vector) of an edge midpoint.

entries.name: sketch.edge.curve
entries.description: Get edge curvature state. Possible return values: 1 = the edge is curved; 0 = edge is linear.

entries.name: sketch.edge.direction
entries.description: Get the direction of an edge. The return is the 2D vector from point1 to point2 of the edge.

entries.name: sketch.edge.extra
entries.description: Get/set the value stored at iin the extra variable array of edge e.

entries.name: sketch.edge.find
entries.description: Get the edge with ID i.

entries.name: sketch.edge.grid.ratio
entries.description: Get/set the ratio setting of an edge. See sketch edge ratio.

entries.name: sketch.edge.grid.ratio.isolate
entries.description: This function only applies to edges that form regular (3- or 4-sided) blocks.

entries.name: sketch.edge.grid.size
entries.description: Get/set the number of zones (grid size) on edge.

entries.name: sketch.edge.gridpos
entries.description: Get the position of a grid point. The function returns a position (2D vector). Grid point indices range from 0 to sketch.edge.grid.size.

entries.name: sketch.edge.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to edge e in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: sketch.edge.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the edge in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: sketch.edge.id
entries.description: Get the edge ID number, a unique number assigned by the code when it is created.

entries.name: sketch.edge.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the edge and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: sketch.edge.length
entries.description: Get the length of an edge.

entries.name: sketch.edge.list
entries.description: Get a pointer to the container of all edges in the sketch set.

entries.name: sketch.edge.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum ID number assigned to any edge in the set sp. The next edge created will be assigned this value plus one.

entries.name: sketch.edge.next.edge
entries.description: Get the next edge connected to the point with local index i within the source edge ep. This can be used to iterate through all edges connected to a point using the sketch.edge.next.index function.

entries.name: sketch.edge.next.index
entries.description: Get local index inext of a point within the next edge attached to this point (note: the same point has local index i within the source edge ep).

entries.name: sketch.edge.num
entries.description: Get the total number of edges in the set sp.

entries.name: sketch.edge.parampos
entries.description: Get the position of parameterized location v. Returns a 2D vector (x,y). Values of f should range between 0.0 and 1.0.

entries.name: sketch.edge.point
entries.description: Get a point of an edge. The edge endpoint index may be 1 or 2.

entries.name: sketch.edge.poly.add
entries.description: Add a control point. The point is added at position v. If the edge type is simple line, the edge type will be changed to polyline type.

entries.name: sketch.edge.poly.delete
entries.description: Delete control point i of an edge. Control point indices start at 1.

entries.name: sketch.edge.poly.localu
entries.description: Get/set the local parametric f coordinate of an edge control point. Control point indices start at 1.

entries.name: sketch.edge.poly.localv
entries.description: Get/set the local parametric f coordinate of an edge control point. Control point indices start at 1.

entries.name: sketch.edge.poly.point
entries.description: Get/set the position of a control point on an edge. Control point indices start at 1.

entries.name: sketch.edge.poly.size
entries.description: Get the number of the control points on an edge.

entries.name: sketch.edge.simple
entries.description: Get the control point usage of an edge. Possible return values are: true = edge is linear, has no control points; false = edge has control points.

entries.name: sketch.edge.start.block
entries.description: Get the first block on the list of blocks attached to an edge.

entries.name: sketch.edge.start.index
entries.description: Get local index i of edge ep within the first block attached to the edge. This can be used to iterate through all blocks attached to an edge with the sketch.edge.start.block, sketch.block.next.block and sketch.block.next.index functions.

entries.name: sketch.edge.type
entries.description: Get/set the edge type. Possible return/assignment values are: 0 = simple, 1 = polyline, 2 = arc, 3 = curve (represented by a B-spline).

entries.name: sketch.edge.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of object. For edges, this will always return 1286571528.

entries.name: sketch.point.blocks
entries.description: Get the list of all blocks connected to the point p

entries.name: sketch.point.edges
entries.description: Get the list of all edges connected to the point p

entries.name: sketch.point.extra
entries.description: Get/set the value stored at iin the extra variable array of point p.

entries.name: sketch.point.find
entries.description: Get the point with ID i.

entries.name: sketch.point.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to point p in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: sketch.point.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the point in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: sketch.point.id
entries.description: Get the point ID number, a unique number assigned by the code when it is created.

entries.name: sketch.point.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the point and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: sketch.point.list
entries.description: Get a pointer to the container of all points in the sketch set.

entries.name: sketch.point.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum ID number assigned to any point in the set sp. The next point created will be assigned this value plus one.

entries.name: sketch.point.num
entries.description: Get the total number of points in the set sp.

entries.name: sketch.point.pos
entries.description: Get/set the position of a point.

entries.name: sketch.point.start.edge
entries.description: Get the first edge on the list of edges connected to a point.

entries.name: sketch.point.start.index
entries.description: Get local index i of point n within the first edge attached to the point. This can be used to iterate through all edges attached to a node with the sketch.point.start.edge, sketch.edge.next.edge and sketch.edge.next.index functions.

entries.name: sketch.point.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of object. For points, this will always return 1286571333.

entries.name: sketch.segment.center
entries.description: Get the position (3D vector) of a segment midpoint.

entries.name: sketch.segment.count
entries.description: Get the number segments in the sketch set.

entries.name: sketch.segment.curve
entries.description: Get segment curvature state. Possible return values: 1 = the segment is curved; 0 = segment is linear.

entries.name: sketch.segment.direction
entries.description: Get the direction of a segment. The return is the 3D vector from point1 to point2 of the segment.

entries.name: sketch.segment.extra
entries.description: Get/set the value stored at iin the extra variable array of segment e.

entries.name: sketch.segment.find
entries.description: Get the segment with ID i.

entries.name: sketch.segment.find.linear
entries.description: Get the segment with index position i. It assumes that All segments are linear and all segments are connected.

entries.name: sketch.segment.grid.ratio
entries.description: Get/set the ratio setting of a segment. See sketch segment ratio.

entries.name: sketch.segment.grid.ratio.isolate
entries.description: Get/set the ratio-isolate flag of a segment: when true, the segment's grid ratio is not propagated along the connected segments.

entries.name: sketch.segment.grid.size
entries.description: Get/set the number of zones (grid size) on segment.

entries.name: sketch.segment.gridpos
entries.description: Get the position of a grid point. The function returns a position (2D vector). Grid point indices range from 0 to sketch.segment.grid.size.

entries.name: sketch.segment.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to segment e in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: sketch.segment.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the segment in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: sketch.segment.id
entries.description: Get the segment ID number, a unique number assigned by the code when it is created.

entries.name: sketch.segment.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the segment and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: sketch.segment.length
entries.description: Get the length of a segment.

entries.name: sketch.segment.list
entries.description: Get a pointer to the container of all segments in the sketch set.

entries.name: sketch.segment.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum ID number assigned to any segment in the set sp. The next segment created will be assigned this value plus one.

entries.name: sketch.segment.next.edge
entries.description: Get the next segment attached to node i (1 or 2) of the segment along the extrusion path.

entries.name: sketch.segment.next.index
entries.description: Get local index inext of a point within the next segment attached to this node (note: the same node has local index i within the source segment ep).

entries.name: sketch.segment.node
entries.description: Get a node of an segment. The segment endpoint index may be 1 or 2.

entries.name: sketch.segment.node.count
entries.description: Get the total number of nodes in the set sp.

entries.name: sketch.segment.node.create
entries.description: Create a node at position v.

entries.name: sketch.segment.node.delete
entries.description: Delete a node from the extrusion path.

entries.name: sketch.segment.node.extra
entries.description: Get/set the value stored at iin the extra variable array of node p.

entries.name: sketch.segment.node.find
entries.description: Get the segment node with ID i.

entries.name: sketch.segment.node.find.linear
entries.description: Get node i of the set by its position in the node list (a linear index), rather than by ID.

entries.name: sketch.segment.node.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to segment node p in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: sketch.segment.node.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the node in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: sketch.segment.node.id
entries.description: Get the node ID number, a unique number assigned by the code when it is created.

entries.name: sketch.segment.node.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the node and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: sketch.segment.node.list
entries.description: Get a pointer to the container of all nodes in the sketch set.

entries.name: sketch.segment.node.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum ID number assigned to any node in the set sp. The next node created will be assigned this value plus one.

entries.name: sketch.segment.node.num
entries.description: Get the total number of nodes in the set sp.

entries.name: sketch.segment.node.pos
entries.description: Get/set the position of a node.

entries.name: sketch.segment.node.removegroup
entries.description: Remove the group s from a segment node (or from node i of a set) in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: sketch.segment.node.segments
entries.description: Get the list of all segments connected to the node p

entries.name: sketch.segment.node.start.index
entries.description: Get local index i of point n within the first edge attached to the point. This can be used to iterate through all edges attached to a node with the sketch.segment.node.start.edge, sketch.edge.next.edge and sketch.edge.next.index functions.

entries.name: sketch.segment.node.start.segment
entries.description: Get the first segment on the list of segments connected to a node.

entries.name: sketch.segment.node.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of object. It can be used with type.pointer.id to tell sketch segment node pointers from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: sketch.segment.num
entries.description: Get the total number of segments in the set sp.

entries.name: sketch.segment.parampos
entries.description: Get the position of parameterized location v. Returns a 3D vector (x,y,z). Values of f should range between 0.0 and 1.0.

entries.name: sketch.segment.poly.add
entries.description: Add a control point. The point is added at position v. If the segment type is simple line, the segment type will be changed to polyline type.

entries.name: sketch.segment.poly.delete
entries.description: Delete control point i of a segment. Control point indices start at 1.

entries.name: sketch.segment.poly.localu
entries.description: Get/set the local parametric f coordinate of a segment control point. Control point indices start at 1.

entries.name: sketch.segment.poly.localv
entries.description: Get/set the local parametric f coordinate of a segment control point. Control point indices start at 1.

entries.name: sketch.segment.poly.localw
entries.description: Get/set the local parametric f coordinate of a segment control point. Control point indices start at 1.

entries.name: sketch.segment.poly.point
entries.description: Get/set the position of a control point on an segment. Control point indices start at 1.

entries.name: sketch.segment.poly.size
entries.description: Get the number of the control points on a segment.

entries.name: sketch.segment.removegroup
entries.description: Remove the group s from the segment in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: sketch.segment.simple
entries.description: Get the control point usage of a segment. Possible return values are: true = segment is linear, has no control points; false = segment has control points.

entries.name: sketch.segment.start.index
entries.description: Get the local index of the segment's start point (see sketch.segment.next.index).

entries.name: sketch.segment.type
entries.description: Get/set the segment type. Possible return/assignment values are: 0 = simple, 1 = polyline, 2 = curve (represented by a B-spline).

entries.name: sketch.set.axis.u
entries.description: Get/set the local (horizontal) u-axis.

entries.name: sketch.set.axis.uv
entries.description: Set the local u- and v-axes of the sketch set from the two vectors given; the third axis follows. Returns true on success.

entries.name: sketch.set.axis.uw
entries.description: Set the local u- and w-axes of the sketch set from the two vectors given; the third axis follows. Returns true on success.

entries.name: sketch.set.axis.v
entries.description: Get/set the local (vertical) v-axis.

entries.name: sketch.set.axis.vw
entries.description: Set the local v- and w-axes of the sketch set from the two vectors given; the third axis follows. Returns true on success.

entries.name: sketch.set.axis.w
entries.description: The function only applies to 3D case (when 3D zones are generated from Sketch).

entries.name: sketch.set.badzones
entries.description: Check whether or not any elements in the set have bad geometries based on the sketch criteria (the check is performed for quadrilateral elements only).

entries.name: sketch.set.block.create
entries.description: Create a block from points with ID i1, i2, i3, etc.

entries.name: sketch.set.block.delete
entries.description: Delete a block.

entries.name: sketch.set.block.find
entries.description: Get a block by ID.

entries.name: sketch.set.block.list
entries.description: Get a list of all blocks in sketch set sp.

entries.name: sketch.set.block.near
entries.description: Get the block nearest to a position. Null is returned if no block is found.

entries.name: sketch.set.block.size
entries.description: Get the number of blocks in the sketch set.

entries.name: sketch.set.create
entries.description: Create a sketch set. The function returns a pointer to the the created set.

entries.name: sketch.set.delete
entries.description: Delete a sketch set.

entries.name: sketch.set.edge.combine
entries.description: Combine a set of edges into a single curved edge ep.

entries.name: sketch.set.edge.create
entries.description: Create an edge from two points. The points may be provided by ID or by pointer.

entries.name: sketch.set.edge.delete
entries.description: Delete an edge.

entries.name: sketch.set.edge.find
entries.description: Get an edge by ID.

entries.name: sketch.set.edge.list
entries.description: Get a list of all edges in sketch set sp.

entries.name: sketch.set.edge.near
entries.description: Get the edge nearest a position. The function returns null if no edge is found.

entries.name: sketch.set.edge.size
entries.description: Get number of edges in the sketch set.

entries.name: sketch.set.find
entries.description: Get a sketch set by name or ID.

entries.name: sketch.set.id
entries.description: Get the ID of a sketch set.

entries.name: sketch.set.list
entries.description: Get a list of extrude sets.

entries.name: sketch.set.metadata.find
entries.description: Get a metadata value from a metadata key.

entries.name: sketch.set.metadata.key
entries.description: Get a metadata key from a metadata container index.

entries.name: sketch.set.metadata.size
entries.description: Get the number of metadata objects in the metadata container.

entries.name: sketch.set.metadata.value
entries.description: Get a metadata value from a metadata key. In place of s1 an index position in the metadata container may be supplied.

entries.name: sketch.set.name
entries.description: Get the name of a sketch set.

entries.name: sketch.set.origin
entries.description: Get/set the origin of the sketch transformation. When extruded, the sketch coordinate system origin (0,0) is mapped to zones coordinate origin specified by vector v.

entries.name: sketch.set.point.create
entries.description: Create a point at a position.

entries.name: sketch.set.point.delete
entries.description: Delete a point.

entries.name: sketch.set.point.find
entries.description: Get a point by ID.

entries.name: sketch.set.point.list
entries.description: Get a list of all points in set sp.

entries.name: sketch.set.point.near
entries.description: Get the point nearest a position. The function returns null if no point is found.

entries.name: sketch.set.point.size
entries.description: Get number of points in the extrude set.

entries.name: sketch.set.region.element.num
entries.description: Get the number of elements in a block with ID i.

entries.name: sketch.set.region.nodes
entries.description: Get the list of 2D vectors that correspond to the positions of the nodes of an element with local index i within a block with ID ib.

entries.name: sketch.set.zone.autodir
entries.description: The function only applies to 3D case (when 3D zones are generated from the sketch).

entries.name: sketch.set.zone.count2
entries.description: Get the number of 2D elements (zones) in the xy plane.

entries.name: sketch.set.zone.count3
entries.description: The function only applies to 3D case (when 3D zones are generated from the sketch).

entries.name: sketch.set.zone.target.edge
entries.description: Get/set the auto-zoning edge length. The default is 1.0.

entries.name: sketch.set.zone.target.minsize
entries.description: Get/set the auto-zoning minimum zone-count target of the set (companion of sketch.set.zone.target.edge).

entries.name: sketch.set.zone.target.size
entries.description: Get/set the autozoning size (number of zones). The default is 100.

entries.name: sketch.set.zone.target.total
entries.description: Get/set the auto-zoning total (number of zones). The default is 100.
